1.why: All MFA endpoints resolve state via getSession(req) and mfa(s.accountId) only, never a client-supplied account id.

2.why: Challenges, TOTP secrets, and backup codes are bound to the session/account; the same code does not authenticate a different user.

3.why: Enabling MFA in verify-otp updates mfas only and does not invalidate or delete other existing sessions in the sessions map.

4.why: OTP secret is stored AES-GCM encrypted (encrypt/decrypt) and backup codes are PBKDF2-hashed via protect().

6.why: Session/challenge cookies are HttpOnly; no localStorage/sessionStorage or non-HttpOnly cookie writes for secrets/OTPs/tokens.

7.why: Server validates email, phone, OTP, recovery codes, and redirect with emailOK/phoneOK/otpOK/recoveryInput and related checks.

8.why: UI sets dynamic values with textContent; API returns JSON; HTML shell is static with CSP nonces, not unencoded user HTML.

9.why: signin accepts redirect only if null or in the ROUTES allow-list; no open external redirects are issued.

10.why: secureHeaders sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors 'none'.

11.why: sessionCookie and challengeCookie set HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict on __Host- cookies.

12.why: Client deliberately logs manualSecret and backup codes to the on-page Logs/console; TEST_MODE also returns mockCode in API JSON.

13.why: Identity challenges are single-use with expiresAt; provisioning is time-bound; TOTP counter replay blocked; recovery codes marked used.

14.why: identityAttempts, otpAttempts, and recoveryAttempts lock after MAX_FAILURES (5) for LOCK_MS (10 minutes).

15.why: signin deletes prior session cookie id and issues a new session id; idle/absolute timeouts enforced; logout deletes the session.
